Apps by DrGonzo65.
**LivePoster** turns any screen into a movie poster display for your home theatre. It watches Kaleidescape, Plex and Jellyfin, shows the poster for whatever is playing, and cycles your library as a "Coming Soon" slideshow when nothing is.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/DrGonzo65/liveposter/issues
